title: Sources: Tencent founder Pony Ma says in his annual speech that he is willing to deploy half of the company's 100,000-strong workforce to AI-native businesses (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Tencent founder Pony Ma says in his annual speech that he is willing to deploy half of the company's 100,000-strong workforce to AI-native businesses — Tencent Holdings Ltd.'s billionaire founder Pony Ma said he's willing to deploy half of his troops to AI-native businesses …
